source: Later handbooks will treat the hierarchy quantitatively. For AS01, remember the roles: registers are thread-local state, shared memory is explicit on-chip cooperation/reuse, caches are hardwaremanaged locality, and device memory provides large capacity at much greater distance from the execution pipelines.
zh: 以后的手册将对层次结构进行定量处理。对于 AS01，请记住这些角色：寄存器是线程本地状态，共享内存是显式片上协作/重用，缓存是硬件管理的局部性，设备内存在距执行管道更远的距离处提供大容量。
